name: US Primary Numbers
description: Primary address numbers: fractions, trailing letters, ranges, Queens and Hawaii hyphenated numbers, Utah grid addresses, Wisconsin grid numbers and numbers spelled out. Shapes follow USPS Publication 28 (a US government work, public domain); inputs are constructed for this corpus unless a case's source says otherwise.
